# grove clone: GitHub CLI arguments and failures are tested offline

mkdir source
exec git init source
cd source
cp ../README.md .
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'
cd ..

env FAKE_GH_LOG=$WORK/gh.log
env FAKE_GH_REPO=file://$WORK/source
exec grove clone --shallow https://github.com/acme/widgets workspace
exists workspace/main/README.md

env FAKE_GH_FAIL='repo clone'
env FAKE_GH_EXIT=23
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='fake clone failure'
! exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets failed
stderr 'fake clone failure'

cmpenv gh.log want-gh.log

-- README.md --
# Test

-- want-gh.log --
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/workspace/.bare","--","--bare","--depth","1"]
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/failed/.bare","--","--bare"]
